releases.title: HengWorld: a paid step is done once (branch hengworld-paid-step-once at 199a7ca)
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Install: extract hengworld-delivery-v030.tgz (the tree of the pull request branch: dev bb9bec8 plus five instruction texts), create a venv, pip install the seven packages under src/ (hutian, researchworld, gameworld, videoworld, dojoworld, kaitianworld, hengworld), build the hengworld images from their Dockerfiles as DEV.md says.

releases.title: HengWorld v0.2.0: executor, plain function texts, CI lines
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Assembled delivery tree (PR #7 branch hengworld plus docs/). Install: extract, install the seven src/*/ packages in one venv, build src/hengworld/Dockerfile and worker.Dockerfile (see install.sh).

releases.title: HengWorld package, first installable version
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Assembled delivery tree (builder root + architect graphs + writer instructions) as hengworld-delivery.tgz. Install: extract it, then pip install ./src/hutian ./src/hengworld and build the images as USER.md 1.3 says (docker build --build-arg HUTIAN_VERSION=3.1.0 --build-arg HUTIAN_COMMIT=<sha> -f src/hengworld/Dockerfile -t hengworld:local .).
